goal: Alert maintainers in advance when the Windows code signing certificate is near expiry
Prevent release delays on sudden or expedited point releases caused by expired certificates
agreement: Strong support because automated checks avoid relying on manual memory during releases (fanquake)
Suggests making the verification script stand-alone so it can run locally (maflcko)
Suggests also checking the CRL URL for certificate revocation (achow101)
